summary: Diana Reeves led a Customer Success review of at-risk accounts with Maria Santos, Aisha Johnson and Brian Cho. Brightpath renewed for two years after detection tuning cut alerts from ~180 to 41 per day, and Keystone Health signed a Detect add-on. Summit Trust renewed for only one year on Identity and Detect while piloting VaultEdge, and Northstar Pharma remains open with a SentinelShield proof of concept planned for June and the permanent Comply v2 export fix slipping to mid-June. Ironworks Corp churned to Fortiguard Pro (~$140K ACV), citing the March outage, OT monitoring gaps and late ISO 27001 reporting. Silverline's Protect seats (~30% of the account) are at risk after a restore failure caused by a dedup bug. Brian counted at least six support cases this quarter tracing back to the March remediation, which Diana will raise with engineering leadership as a systemic pattern.
actionItems: Maria Santos: Build a save plan for Northstar Pharma before their June SentinelShield proof of concept, due Tuesday
Brian Cho: Compile all support cases linked to the March Detect remediation by Monday
Aisha Johnson: Write a Brightpath Commerce renewal case study
Diana Reeves: Write up the Ironworks loss for the win-loss review
Diana Reeves: Raise the remediation side-effect pattern with engineering leadership and flag the slipped Comply export fix
